questions.question_text: Determine residential status of Vijay for the assessment year 2023-24, along with detailed workings.
questions.model_answer: Mr. Vijay has stayed in India for 349 days during the previous year 2022-23 (365 days - 16 days). He satisfies the basic condition of being in India for 182 days or more. He also satisfies the additional conditions of being a resident in 2 out of the 10 preceding previous years and staying for 730 days or more in the 7 preceding previous years. Therefore, Mr. Vijay is resident and ordinarily resident in India for the Assessment Year 2023-24.
